purpose: Research-only. Permit facts by river, quoted from the managing agency. Nothing was applied for or submitted.

statewide.fact: Inflatable PFDs are not allowed on any rivers in Utah (quoted on the NPS Canyonlands river page).
statewide.quote: Inflatable PFDs are not allowed on any rivers in Utah.

green-river-dinosaur.quote: Permits are required for all river trips within Dinosaur National Monument.
green-river-dinosaur.detail: Multiday (Lodore) permits are issued by lottery; the Rainbow Park-Split Mountain day section needs a one-day permit (section currently excluded: closed).

green-river-desolation.quote: A permit is required year round for floating the Desolation Gray Canyons section of the Green River.
green-river-desolation.detail: Nefertiti-Swaseys day section, BLM WSR page: 'This river segment does not require a permit.'

green-river-labyrinth.quote: Permits may be downloaded from BLM.gov and emailed to blm_ut_labyrinth@blm.gov.
green-river-labyrinth.detail: BLM permit, self-issued by download and email (the package has not submitted one). NPS: 'Permits are required for boating the Green River between Green River State Park and Mineral Bottom (Labyrinth Canyon).'
green-river-labyrinth.fee: not stated on the BLM page

colorado-river-westwater.quote: permits are required year-round for private and commercial use.

colorado-river-moab.quote: Permits are not required for overnight use or launches on BLM land along the Colorado River.
colorado-river-moab.note: Quoted from the NPS Canyonlands flatwater page; the BLM Moab Daily map gives no permit statement.

colorado-river-meander.permitRequired: only for nights inside Canyonlands NP
colorado-river-meander.quote: A river permit is required for all noncommercial river travel on the Green and Colorado rivers. (Canyonlands NP)  /  Permits are not required for overnight use or launches on BLM land along the Colorado River.
colorado-river-meander.note: Moab Bridge to Potash is upstream of the park on BLM land, so no permit applies to the section itself; continuing below Potash needs an NPS permit.

san-juan.quote: A permit is required year-round to float any section of the San Juan River between Montezuma Creek and Clay Hills in southeast Utah.

san-rafael.note: No permit statement found on the BLM Fuller Bottom / Swinging Bridge pages.

green-river-flaming-gorge.note: Fee areas (USFS/BLM) at launches; no float permit stated.

white-river.note: BLM brochure: 'Non-commercial use on BLM land is free, no permit'. Use of Uintah and Ouray Reservation lands requires separate tribal permits (brochure).

notRequested: No permit, lottery entry or form was submitted. Agencies were not contacted.
